Sub: Information regarding loss of share certificate (s)  
 
Pursuant to Regulation 39(3) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we enclose  the information 
regarding loss of share certificate (s) for 10,593 (Ten Thousand Five Hundred  and Ninety  
Three ) shares received from the shareholder(s) of the Company on July 22, 202 4. As 
required under SEBI Circular No.  SEBI / HO / MIRSD / MIRSD_RTAMB /  P /CIR /2022/8 
dated January 25, 202 2, the Company shall issue ’Letter of Confirmation’ to the 
shareholder s after compliance of required formalities.  
 
Please take the same on record.  
 
Thanking you,  
 
Yours faithfully,  
For Reliance Industries Limited
